annotation.title_clean: 国家戦略特別区域法施行規則
annotation.title_en: Ordinance for Enforcement of the National Strategic Special Zones Act
annotation.summary_en: Japanese Cabinet Office ordinance implementing the National Strategic Special Zones Act. It sets procedures for business implementation plans, area plan certification, tax and interest-subsidy incentives, and data-sharing platforms. Embodied AI appears only in passing: R&D and manufacture of surgical-assist and nursing-care robots, and autonomous IoT products, qualify as designated projects.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines eligible special-zone projects, including R&D/manufacture of robots for surgical assistance, daily-living training, medical and nursing care (Art. 1, 11-2).
Sets procedures for submitting business implementation plans and area plan certification applications.
Establishes designation of corporations and companies for tax incentives, with annual reporting requirements.
Provides data-platform safety management confirmation and procedures for requesting data from government bodies.
Covers interest subsidy for designated financial institutions and requests for new regulatory exceptions.
